strings.name: Fei-Fei Li
strings.role: Computer scientist · ImageNet and human-centered AI
strings.summary: Li helped develop ImageNet and visual recognition benchmarks, providing foundations for deep learning research. At Stanford she researches computer vision and medical AI, and helped establish AI4ALL and the Institute for Human-Centered AI, emphasizing education, inclusion and human needs. She co-founded World Labs in 2024 to explore spatial intelligence, shared the 2025 Queen Elizabeth Prize for Engineering, and became the Stanford president's special adviser on AI in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 2026-11-13; selected institutional and career developments reach 2026. ImageNet is a team project. The spatial intelligence company's ambitions are not treated as capabilities already achieved.

strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: ImageNet and visual recognition
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Worked with a team to build a large image database and benchmarks supporting image classification and deep learning.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Human-centered AI and education
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Helped found Stanford HAI and AI4ALL, connecting AI research with social impact and wider educational opportunity.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Becomes special adviser on AI
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Stanford HAI's official timeline records her move to special adviser on AI to President Jonathan Levin.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Shares the Queen Elizabeth Prize
strings.timeline.event-02.text: Received the engineering prize with six other laureates for contributions to modern machine learning.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: World Labs becomes public
strings.timeline.event-03.text: With co-founders, announced a spatial intelligence company exploring models that understand and generate three-dimensional worlds.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Helps establish Stanford HAI
strings.timeline.event-04.text: Helped launch an interdisciplinary institute connecting AI research with human needs and social impact.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Helps establish AI4ALL
strings.timeline.event-05.text: Expanded earlier summer-school work into a nonprofit encouraging students from more backgrounds to enter AI.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: ImageNet paper and Stanford appointment
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Published the image database paper with her team; joined Stanford's faculty that year.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Completes engineering doctorate
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Completed her PhD at Caltech after studying physics at Princeton.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Born in Beijing
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Born in China; later moved to the United States for education and research.
strings.influence.rationale: Helped establish ImageNet and advance computer vision; promoted human-centered AI and broader access to technical education.
